name: QNX-RasPi-Setup-Util
tagline: An interactive terminal utility that configures a Raspberry Pi running QNX without editing config files.

awards: QNX: Best Use of QNX: Hardware and Software Prizes

problem: Setting up QNX on a Raspberry Pi needs terminal and Unix experience that many robotics team members lack.
solution: A C++ text-interface program walks through the essential configuration steps interactively.
demo_moment: Team-described: run the wizard and get a configured board.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “QNX: Best Use of QNX: Hardware and Software Prizes” among 261 submissions.
Solves the setup pain the sponsor's own hardware creates.

lessons: Fixing friction in the sponsor's own onboarding is a direct path to its prize.
